description: Header file defining utility classes and functions for Thunder plugin communication, including security token management, HTTP requests, and plugin lifecycle functions.

classes.name: Utils::SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve and cache a security token, and checks if Thunder security is configured.

classes.name: Utils::Job
classes.description: A dispatchable task wrapper that executes a given function when dispatched.

methods.name: Utils::SecurityToken::getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, caching it for subsequent calls.

methods.name: Utils::SecurityToken::writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Callback for curl to write response data into a string.

methods.name: Utils::SecurityToken::isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Thunder security features are configured by querying a local service.

methods.name: Utils::getThunderControllerClient
methods.description: Creates a client connection to the Thunder controller with appropriate security token.

methods.name: Utils::Job
methods.description: Constructor that takes a function to execute, and dispatch method to run it.

methods.name: getServiceState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a plugin service by call sign.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a plugin identified by its call sign.
